method: GitHub connected repository GETs; selected craft-libs also verified by host git checkout

repositories.manifest:
[workspace]
resolver = "3"
members = ["crates/*"]

[workspace.package]
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
rust-version = "1.90"
repository = "https://github.com/storytold/craft-ai-integrations"

[workspace.dependencies]
craft-ai-core = { path = "crates/ai-core" }
craft-ai-http = { path = "crates/ai-http" }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
# All date/time conversion goes through chrono (no hand-rolled calendar code; CONTRIBUTING.md).
chrono = { version = "0.4.45", default-features = false, features = ["std"] }

[workspace.lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"

[workspace.lints.clippy]
dbg_macro = "warn"
todo = "warn"

[workspace]
resolver = "3"
members = ["crates/*", "apps/*", "xtask"]
# The plugin SDK and examples build for wasm32 in a workspace of their own (`cargo xtask plugins`).
exclude = ["plugins"]
# default-members = ["crates/*", "apps/figcraft", "apps/figcraft-cli", "xtask"]

[workspace.package]
version = "0.10.0"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
rust-version = "1.95"
repository = "https://github.com/storytold/figcraft"

[workspace.dependencies]
# internal
figcraft-geom = { path = "crates/geom" }
figcraft-color = { path = "crates/color" }
figcraft-doc = { path = "crates/doc" }
figcraft-layout = { path = "crates/layout" }
figcraft-text = { path = "crates/text" }
figcraft-pathops = { path = "crates/pathops" }
figcraft-render = { path = "crates/render" }
figcraft-svg = { path = "crates/svg" }
figcraft-pdf = { path = "crates/pdf" }
figcraft-format = { path = "crates/format" }
figcraft-tools = { path = "crates/tools" }
figcraft-collab = { path = "crates/collab" }
figcraft-engine = { path = "crates/engine" }
figcraft-ui-egui = { path = "crates/ui-egui" }
figcraft-mcp = { path = "crates/mcp" }
figcraft-collab-net = { path = "crates/collab-net" }
figcraft-plugin = { path = "crates/plugin" }

# Which paths stored in a document may be followed (craft-libs).
craft-docpath = { version = "0.1.0", git = "https://github.com/storytold/craft-libs", rev = "82a24b006eefa036b43c09a67fb9a3fbd17ffe63" }
# Who draws the window frame on Linux — the compositor or the app — so every Craft app shows the
# same native titlebar per desktop (craft-libs). The `egui` feature adds `decorate`/`decorations`.
craft-window = { git = "https://github.com/storytold/craft-libs", rev = "1f805378d454dac48b5c214029d254055fdf961b", features = ["egui"] }

# foundation
kurbo = { version = "0.13", features = ["serde"] }
thiserror = "2"
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive", "rc"] }
serde_json = { version = "1", features = ["float_roundtrip"] }
regex = "1.13"
log = "0.4"
# All date/time conversion goes through chrono (no hand-rolled calendar code beyond the 400-year range extension; AGENTS.md).
chrono = { version = "0.4.45", default-features = false, features = ["std"] }
proptest = "1"
imbl = { version = "7", features = ["serde"] }
postcard = { version = "1", default-features = false, features = ["alloc"] }

# rendering / formats
tiny-skia = "0.12"
image = { version = "0.25", default-features = false, features = ["png", "jpeg", "webp", "gif", "bmp", "tiff"] }
# Already built for `image`: embedded ICC profiles (moxcms) and PNG colour chunks (png).
moxcms = "0.8"
png = "0.18"
usvg = "0.48"
krilla = "0.8"
skrifa = "0.47"
harfrust = "0.13"
unicode-bidi = "0.3"
unicode-segmentation = "1.13"
linesweeper = "0.4"
zip = { version = "2", default-features = false, features = ["deflate"] }
# `.fig` import: raw deflate chunks (already built for zip) and zstd chunks (pure Rust, MIT, wasm-safe).
flate2 = { version = "1", default-features = false, features = ["rust_backend"] }
ruzstd = { version = "0.9.1", default-features = false, features = ["std"] }
sha2 = "0.10"
base64 = "0.22"
crc32fast = "1"

# plugins: a pure-Rust, metered WebAssembly interpreter (no JIT; also runs in the web build). The
# portable dispatch loop: tail-call dispatch relies on an LLVM optimisation that unoptimised and
# debug builds may not do, and then a long-running plugin overflows the native stack.
wasmi = { version = "2", default-features = false, features = ["std", "stable", "validate", "portable-dispatch"] }
wat = "1.261"

# ui
egui = "0.36"
egui_extras = { version = "0.36", default-features = false }
eframe = { version = "0.36", default-features = false }
rfd = "0.17"
arboard = { version = "3.6", default-features = false }
webbrowser = "1"

[workspace.lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"

[workspace.lints.clippy]
dbg_macro = "warn"
# Style lints from newer toolchains that fight index-heavy pixel code.
needless_range_loop = "allow"
chunks_exact_to_as_chunks = "allow"
# FigCraft never crashes: shipped code returns `Result`/`Option` instead of panicking (see
# AGENTS.md › Never crash). Tests may unwrap (clippy.toml).
unwrap_used = "deny"
expect_used = "deny"
panic = "deny"
todo = "deny"
unimplemented = "deny"
unreachable = "deny"

[profile.dev.package."*"]
opt-level = 2

[profile.dev]
opt-level = 1

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 4

# The browser build only (apps/figcraft-web/index.html: data-cargo-profile). Optimised for size:
# packaging/web/package.sh fails a .wasm over 24 MiB (Cloudflare's per-file cap is 25 MiB).
# wasm32-unknown-unknown always aborts on panic, so panic = "abort" changes nothing there.
[profile.web-release]
inherits = "release"
opt-level = "s"
lto = "fat"
codegen-units = 1
debug = false
strip = true
panic = "abort"

[workspace.package]
# Common inheritable settings for monorepo packages
publish = false

[workspace.dependencies]
# Hakari workspace hack (faster compile times)
#
# If an unrelated leaf package starts causing general build problems,
# for packages including hakari, look up what depends on the bad package:
#
#   `cargo tree --target all  -p {BAD_PACKAGE_NAME} -i`
#
# Packages to remove from hakari to ensure we can build in Netlify,
# Github Actions (without package installs), etc.:
#
#  - cudarc
#  - esaxx-rs
#  - ort
#  - tauri
#  - tauri-runtime-wry
#  - tauri-utils
#
# Broken on Windows:
#  - core-foundation
#  - core-foundation-sys
#
workspace-build-acceleration = { path = "crates/workspace-build-acceleration" }

[workspace.package]

rust-version = "1.95"

[profile.release]
# lto = true # VERY slightly smaller wasm
# opt-level = 's' # 10-20% smaller wasm compared to `opt-level = 3`
# opt-level = 1 # very slow and big wasm. Don't do this.
opt-level = 2 # fast and small wasm, basically same as `opt-level = 's'`
# opt-level = 3 # unnecessarily large wasm for no performance gain

# debug = true # include debug symbols, useful when profiling wasm

panic = "abort" # This leads to better optimizations and smaller binaries (and is the default in Wasm anyways).


[profile.dev]
# Can't leave this on by default, because it breaks the Windows build. Related: https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/issues/4897
# split-debuginfo = "unpacked" # faster debug builds on mac
# opt-level = 1                # Make debug builds run faster

# panic = "abort" leads to better optimizations and smaller binaries (and is the default in Wasm anyways),
# but it also means backtraces don't work with the `backtrace` library (https://github.com/rust-lang/backtrace-rs/issues/397).
# egui has a feature where if you hold down all modifiers keys on your keyboard and hover any UI widget,
# you will see the backtrace to that widget, and we don't want to break that feature in dev builds.

[profile.dev.package."*"]
# Optimize all dependencies even in debug builds (does not affect workspace packages):
opt-level = 2
